boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 148 stacks a narrow `13` head on a 6-wide color grid body, creating a building-shaped frame with a bottom `4`/`3` gate. The top blue `8` marker is the final lock — it triggers the BLOCK OUT clear animation. But the green stacks filling the left band must drain before the `8` can move, and clearing the bottom gate too early seals the left band's only downward exit.
landmarks: Block Out Level 148 stacks a narrow `13` head on a 6-wide color grid body, creating a building-shaped frame with a bottom `4`/`3` gate.
The top blue `8` marker is the final lock — it triggers the BLOCK OUT clear animation.
But the green stacks filling the left band must drain before the `8` can move, and clearing the bottom gate too early seals the left band's only downward exit.

quickTips: Unlock the top blue 8 before clearing the center orange cluster.
Thin the left green band only after the head drops to 12.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Slide the top blue/green/yellow row rightward to spend the left red 8 column without splitting the center red stack.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Break the top purple 13 head down to the blue 12 tile by clearing the upper orange and green scraps.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Thin the left green band once the head shows 12 and the left rail drops to 7.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the center orange cluster after the red column unlocks the middle 1 lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Spend the top blue 8 tile (orange border) once the peripheral counters read 12/14/3.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Drain the remaining yellow/blue scraps through the bottom 3 gate.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Clear the last green scraps for the BLOCK OUT finish.

failurePoints: Clearing the center orange cluster before the top blue 8 unlocks, jamming the left 3 lane.
Splitting the center red stack early, blocking the middle 1 lane permanently.
